thread:
Alex: quick brainstorm  we need three battlecard claims for next week's launch: aim at infra buyers + SEs, and keep rebut-ready lines.

Noor: high level pillars: 1) cost predictability for production, 2) engineered tail performance + fallbacks, 3) one runtime across deployment modes. each claim one short line.

Chen: agree. propose short claim phrasing: "Forecastable inference costs for real apps." "Dependable tails with built-in fallbacks." "One API, any deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)."

Sara: sales wants two quick counters per claim. I'll sketch and we can tighten: 
- Cost: "We remove variance so finance can plan without constant overprovisioning." 
- Tails: "Auto-fallbacks (quantized/region) keep UX snappy under spikes." 
- Runtime: "Migrate without code changes, keep observability & controls."

Alex: good. for the benchmark slide: show p50/p95/p99 + cost per 1M tokens. include a 1-line methodology. avoid absolutes.

Chen: Method blurb: `Method: 6k anonymized production prompts (median 125 tokens). Measured p50/p95/p99 latency and normalized token cost. Compared common hosted endpoints to a tuned dedicated setup.`

Noor: legal reminder  no "cheapest" or "always". use comparative wording like "lower unit cost in common production patterns."

Sara: ops asked for a single failure-flow diagram: primary model -> quantized fallback -> regional reroute -> queued backpressure. keeps customer Qs simple.

Alex: action list: Alex  draft 2 headline variants + 60s webinar opener (today); Noor  finalize claim wording + rebut bullets (EOD); Chen  mock chart + one-line methodology (tomorrow); Sara  failure-flow slide + legal-safe phrasing (tomorrow).

ops-bot: created page: https://notion.redwood/competitive/arena-claimworkshop (v1) :white_check_mark:

Chen: dropping two promo variants for quick A/B: 
A: "Predictable costs, predictable performance." 
B: "One API from POC to SLA-ready serving."

Sara: adding a beta quote placeholder: "Redwood Dedicated let us stop guessing inference spend each month."

Alex: tidy and actionable. we'll iterate after Chen's mock and Noor's SE feedback. thanks :rocket:
